classes.name: OpenmrsThreadPoolHolder
classes.description: A utility class that provides a shared thread pool executor for asynchronous operations within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: Executors.newCachedThreadPool
methods.description: Creates a new thread pool that creates new threads as needed, but will reuse previously constructed threads when they are available.
